reason: The original collector always appends a resolved ch127 sentinel after every actual mark. Entity analysis dispatches only ch38. The sentinel is never removed; n_marks resets only before collection and then increments only in md_add_mark. Therefore any ampersand index is at most n_marks-2, including a trailing ampersand without a semicolon.
